answer: An AI-agent economy curbs Sybils via capped epoch burn auctions with slashable bonds. Each round allocates a fixed pool of active slots, requiring every identity to permanently burn a clearing fee and lock collateral for a dispute delta while verifying tasks like saffron or juniper provenance. Because burned fees cannot be refunded or pooled across keys, minting fake identities incurs a direct capital cost per identity. Still, wealthy attackers can outbid and exclude small honest agents.
